column1: # Game addresses for USA 1.0 and USA 1.1.
# USA 1.1 is a recompile, not a relocation: .text shifts by 28 distinct
# piecewise-constant deltas, so a 1.1 address cannot be computed from a 1.0 one.
# Each row here was found by matching content and is re-checked on every build.
#   add a row      python3 tools/mapaddr.py --add NAME 0xADDR
# provenance says how the 1.1 address was established:
#   window W/B [soft]  matched the instruction bytes around it
#   xref N/M           followed N references that all agreed
#   +refcount          and every reference moved with it, none left behind
